text:
Alex: Heads-up — I'm doing the regional bootstrap + artifact fanout for eu-central-3 at 15:00 UTC. Goal: get GitOps sync, registry replication, and a minimal GPU nodepool smoke-tested. Will run the checklist below and hand off to oncall after smoke pass.

Maya: 👍 what do you need from platform ops? I can handle the firewall/egress changes if you list IPs.

Alex: Need: (1) firewall egress for registry replication (outbound to our central registry and CDN), (2) confirm gitops repo branch + image tags are pushed, (3) pre-pull daemonset for common images onto GPU nodes.

infra-bot: CI:artifact-repl-job started — https://ci.redwood.internal/teams/infra/pipelines/artifact-repl/builds/4321 :eyes:

Tony: For egress, allow these CIDRs for the sync workers: 35.198.12.0/24 and 34.102.45.8/29 (these are sync cluster NAT IPs). Also open HTTPS to registry.redwood:443 from 10.0.0.0/16.

Jia: GitOps notes — I'm opening a small PR to pin the eu-central-3 overlay and add imageMirror entries. Remember to use the robot account (deploy-bot) for the push. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/gitops/compare/feature/eu-central-3-mirror

Sam: Pre-pull daemonset I used last time (drop into the run):
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: image-prepull
  namespace: kube-system
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: prepull
        image: registry.redwood/internal/prepull:stable
        args: ["/bin/prepull", "--images-file=/etc/prepull/list.txt"]
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
```
Run `kubectl -n kube-system rollout status ds/image-prepull` and check `kubectl get pods -n kube-system -l app=prepull -o wide` to ensure node coverage.

Maya: We'll also need to validate image TTLs on the mirror and ensure manifests signed. Quick check for replication success: `curl -s https://registry.redwood.internal/api/v2/_catalog | jq .` and on the region sync host `gsutil ls gs://redwood-artifacts/eu-central-3/`

Tony: Two extra notes: (a) use mixed nodepools — 1 on-demand control pool + 2 preemptible GPU pools to keep cost down during ramp; (b) set autoscaler buffer: minNodes=1, maxNodes=10 for gpu-pool initially. Preemptible pool helps but expect some churn.

Alex: Smoke test steps I'm running after replication completes: 1) deploy a tiny inference pod using the mirrored model tag 2) curl /health and generate 16 tokens 3) verify KV cache warmup and that latency < 1200ms P95 on test requests. Commands I will run:
```
kubectl -n prod run smoke --image=registry.redwood/eu-central-3/llm-smoke:canary --restart=Never --command -- sleep 3600
kubectl -n prod exec -it pod/smoke -- curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8080/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":16}'
```

Jia: Also run `helm status redwood-runtime -n redwood` and `kubectl get pods -n redwood -l app=runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[*].status.containerStatuses[*].ready}'` to ensure runtime pods are ready. If GitOps didn't apply, `fluxctl sync` (or the equivalent) is allowed for the bootstrap step.

Maya: I'm pushing the firewall rule now. Will update when done.

infra-bot: Firewall rule update: egress-registry-euc3 applied by Maya — change-id: fw-2026-3789

Tony: FYI, we had an issue last time with registry auth caching — if you see 401s, restart the sync-worker pods: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/registry-sync`.

Sam: Cost/ops note: if you want longer warm-up without paying on-demand GPUs, consider temporarily maxSurge=0 on the rollout and pre-warm with smaller networks on CPU nodes using quantized model for smoke.

Alex: OK doing the replication check now. infra-bot shows job finishing. If I see green, I'll run the smoke and then drop the handoff doc at https://confluence.redwood.internal/ops/region-boot/eu-central-3 with PR link and checklist.

infra-bot: artifact-repl-job completed — success — artifacts mirrored to eu-central-3. build:4321

Alex: Replication green. Deploying smoke pod.

(small pause)

Alex: Smoke generate OK, latency 780ms P95 on this simple test. Runtime pods healthy.

sre-oncall: @Alex good job — please paste the GitOps PR, the runbook link, and add oncall rotation for next 48h in the handoff doc. I'll take oncall for the first 4 hours.

Alex: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/gitops/pull/1024. Handoff doc: https://confluence.redwood.internal/ops/region-boot/eu-central-3. Added oncall rota and next steps (rollout to full capacity, monitor cost).

Maya: Confirmed no firewall regressions seen.

Tony: Leaving a note in the cluster metadata: tag=eu-central-3, bootstrap-by=Alex, prewarm=done.

Alex: Thanks all — handing off to @sre-oncall. If anyone sees registry 5xx or node churn > 30% in 10m, ping infra channel and escalate. :rocket:
